attestations.text: K'UNG Yu-tê 孔有德, d. Aug. 7, 1652, Chinese bannerman in the Plain Red Banner, was a native of Liaotung. He is reported in one source to have been a descendant of Confucius, his ancestors having emigrated earlier from Shantung.
